payload.text:
What I did:
- Verified prior work: `TenantRegistry.remove(id): boolean` already existed in `src/lib/tenants.ts` from the previous run; `POST /webhooks` already 404s on unknown tenants via `deps.tenants.get()`, so deletion flows through automatically.
- Added `DELETE /admin/tenants/:id` in `src/routes/admin.ts`: removes via the registry, answers 404 `{ error: "unknown tenant <id>" }` when absent, otherwise records an audit entry and answers 200 `{ deleted: id }`.
- Added 4 tests in `test/admin.test.ts`: delete known tenant (and list shrinks), 404 for unknown tenant, audit entry written, webhooks 404 after deletion.

decision: DELETE /admin/tenants/:id answers 200 with { deleted: id } and records audit action tenant.deleted mirroring tenant.created.
